<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="27" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">9:41</text>
    <line x1="319" y1="25" x2="323" y2="25" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="22" x2="330" y2="22" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="333" y1="19" x2="337" y2="19" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="23" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="26" x2="354" y2="29" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="360" y="17" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="383" y="21" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#050505"/>
    <rect x="362" y="19" width="16" height="8" rx="2" fill="#050505"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="39,78 29,88 39,98" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="30" y1="88" x2="52" y2="88" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="24" y="151" font-family="Poppins" font-size="30px" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Forgot Password?</text>
    <path d="M25 164 C82 158 137 170 191 164" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.18"/>
    <path d="M25 167 C82 161 137 173 191 167" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.10"/>
    <path d="M199 164 C252 158 305 170 365 164" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.18"/>
    <path d="M199 167 C252 161 305 173 365 167" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.10"/>
    <text x="24" y="202" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">Enter your email or mobile number and we’ll</text>
    <text x="24" y="226" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">send you instructions to reset your password.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Input -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="274" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Email or mobile number</text>
    <rect x="23" y="286" width="344" height="52" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="24" y="285" width="344" height="52" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="39" y="301" width="20" height="15" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="303" x2="49" y2="310" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <line x1="58" y1="303" x2="49" y2="310" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <text x="72" y="317" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#A0A3BD">name@example.com or +1 555 012 3489</text>
    <text x="24" y="361" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#A0A3BD">We’ll never share your contact information.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Recovery information card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="399" width="344" height="116" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
    <rect x="24" y="397" width="344" height="116" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
    <circle cx="55" cy="431" r="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="49" y="428" width="12" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="50" y1="429" x2="55" y2="433" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <line x1="60" y1="429" x2="55" y2="433" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <text x="86" y="430" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Check your inbox</text>
    <text x="86" y="453" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">The reset link may take a few minutes</text>
    <text x="86" y="474" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">to arrive. Also check your spam folder.</text>
    <line x1="40" y1="493" x2="352" y2="493" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="40" y="505" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Need help? Contact support</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Submit button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="686" width="344" height="50" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.10"/>
    <rect x="24" y="684" width="344" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="196" y="715" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="16px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#FFFFFF">Submit</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#000000" opacity="0.05"/>
    <rect x="0" y="764" width="390" height="80" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="764" x2="390" y2="764" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- Explore -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="43" cy="789" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="43" y1="789" x2="48" y2="784" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <circle cx="43" cy="789" r="2" fill="#667080"/>
      <text x="43" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#667080">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Bookmarks -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="124,780 138,780 138,799 131,795 124,799" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="131" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#667080">Saved</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Home active -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="205,786 215,778 225,786" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <rect x="208" y="785" width="14" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="215" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="299" cy="784" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <ellipse cx="299" cy="797" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <text x="299" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#667080">Profile</text>
    </g>
    <!-- More -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="361" cy="783" r="2" fill="#667080"/>
      <circle cx="361" cy="790" r="2" fill="#667080"/>
      <circle cx="361" cy="797" r="2" fill="#667080"/>
      <text x="361" y="824" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#667080">More</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
